en.title: Tariff proposals become concrete, but markets price the process—not the duty
en.deck: USTR's formal determinations and proposed tariffs move trade policy from speculation into consultation, while strong US quarterly growth, sticky PCE inflation, falling Treasury yields and a relief rally reveal a split market response.
en.regime: Global activity remains uneven; US quarterly demand is strong but monthly real consumption is flat, inflation remains elevated, and trade-policy uncertainty is interacting with technology and energy risk.
en.key_risk: Broad final tariff coverage or retaliation could increase landed costs and delay investment while sticky inflation limits monetary-policy flexibility; persistent energy disruption would add a separate price shock.

pt-BR.title: Tarifas propostas ganham forma, mas o mercado precifica o processo — não o imposto
pt-BR.deck: As determinações formais e as tarifas propostas pelo USTR levam a política comercial da especulação à consulta, enquanto crescimento trimestral americano forte, inflação PCE persistente, rendimentos menores dos Treasuries e recuperação das bolsas revelam uma resposta de mercado dividida.
pt-BR.regime: A atividade global permanece desigual; a demanda trimestral americana é forte, mas o consumo real mensal está estável, a inflação continua elevada e a incerteza comercial interage com riscos de tecnologia e energia.
pt-BR.key_risk: Cobertura tarifária final ampla ou retaliação pode elevar custos de importação e atrasar investimentos enquanto a inflação persistente limita a flexibilidade monetária; uma interrupção energética prolongada acrescentaria outro choque de preços.

signal_rationale.delta: Compared with the 25 November edition, which covered tariff expectations before formal findings and the inflation-rate transmission, this edition updates the legal state to published determinations and proposed product-level actions, then tests the market response against the BEA's newly released Q3 GDP second estimate and October PCE. The 24 November issue's regional growth/steel dispersion and the 23 November China ore/steel inventory thesis are not repeated.
signal_rationale.evidence: USTR's 25 November notice lists determinations for 14 economies, proposed additional duties with exceptions/netting and a public-comment process through 5 January 2027. BEA released Q3 real GDP at 4.3% annualized and October PCE inflation at 3.8% headline/3.3% core. Reuters reports the 25 November equity/yield close and 26 November Asian rebound; Treasury/FRED reports the 10-year yield; Eurostat, IIF and worldsteel provide dated cross-region inflation, flows and output data.
signal_rationale.scale_path: Formal trade-policy findings affect product coverage and expected landed costs; firms adjust sourcing, inventories and investment; import prices and margins transmit to inflation and trade volumes; monetary expectations, yields, FX and cross-border funding respond.
signal_rationale.transmission: USTR determination → consultation/final coverage/effective date → tariff incidence and sourcing → import prices, margins, trade and capex → inflation expectations, central-bank reaction, yields, currencies and capital flows.
signal_rationale.falsifier: The thesis weakens if final coverage is narrow or delayed, net landed costs barely change, trade and capex remain stable, core goods inflation disinflates and energy shipping/export data show no sustained supply loss.

key_constraints: Tariffs remain proposed; product annexes, exclusions, effective dates and final negotiated changes must be monitored.
Market observations are from different reporting windows; US cash markets are closed on 26 November for Thanksgiving.
PCE, GDP, HICP and steel-output series have different scopes and cannot be treated as one comparable measure.
The IIF capital-flow estimate is October monthly data, not November daily flow.
Oil and shipping incident claims are attributed to Reuters and not independently verified in this report.

producer_checks.novelty_decision: The new delta is formal USTR determinations/proposed measures plus released BEA GDP/PCE data; this is not merely a calendar update to 25 November. The 24 November regional PMI/steel and 23 November China ore-inventory theses are not repeated.

reproducibility_notes.tariffs: USTR 25 November 2026 determination and proposed-action notice. Rates are ceilings proposed for consultation, with product exclusions and netting/conditional agreements; they are not final duties in force. Comments due 5 January 2027; hearings from 25 January.
reproducibility_notes.us_gdp: BEA second estimate for Q3 2026, release 25 November: real GDP +4.3% annualized; final sales to private domestic purchasers +5.8%; revised from 3.4% advance estimate. Quarterly annualized series.
reproducibility_notes.us_pce: BEA October 2026 PIO release 25 November: headline PCE +0.3% m/m/+3.8% y/y; core +0.3% m/m/+3.3% y/y; real PCE essentially 0.0% m/m; saving rate 4.1%.
reproducibility_notes.market_window: Reuters reports US session 25 November (Dow +0.33%, S&P -0.25%, Nasdaq -0.62%, 10-year yield 4.84%, down 6.2bp) and early Asia snapshot 26 November (Nikkei +1.6%, Korea +1.9%, APAC ex-Japan +0.6%). US cash market closed for Thanksgiving on 26 November.
reproducibility_notes.euro_inflation: Eurostat final October 2026 HICP released 18 November: euro area 4.0% y/y; energy contributed 1.89pp and services 1.55pp.
reproducibility_notes.em_flows: IIF November tracker released 5 November: nonresident EM portfolio outflows $33.8bn in October; monthly estimate, not November daily data.
reproducibility_notes.steel: worldsteel 24 November release: October production 142.4Mt across 70 reporting economies, -1.1% y/y; regional/country figures are production, not final demand.
reproducibility_notes.brazil_policy: BCB Copom November 2026 statement maintains Selic at 13.75% p.a.; Brazil is not among the 14 economies named in the USTR determination.
reproducibility_notes.oil: Reuters 26 November reports Brent around $94.7/bbl and attributes supply concerns to claimed attacks/shipping reports; incident attribution is not independently verified here.
reproducibility_notes.source_independence: Reuters provides market-window observations and attribution; primary USTR, BEA, Treasury/FRED, Eurostat, IIF, worldsteel, BCB and EIA sources support legal, statistical and policy claims.
